description: Numeric action bounds, applied AFTER the Reflection critic has passed. Reflection is a semantic check ('compliance by review'); this is the numeric one ('compliance by design'). Neither substitutes for the other.

negotiation.note: The mediator's SLA is clipped to [0, achievable at 100% PRB] and its share vector is renormalised to sum to 1 with no tenant below min_share_fraction. AGIRAN had no guardrail at this tier; a share vector is easy for a model to get arithmetically wrong, so it gets one.
